HERO.TITLE: ABOUT US
HERO.TAGLINE: HOMESTAY DORM — NURTURING YOUR JOURNEY, BUILDING YOUR HOME.
HERO.QUOTE: "More than just a dormitory, we provide a professional living ecosystem designed for the young generation to grow, connect, and thrive in a safe and transparent environment."

STORY.INTRO: HomeStay Dorm was founded on a deep understanding of the challenges students and young professionals face when searching for a place to call home in a dynamic city. We reimagined the dormitory concept — combining the discipline of a professional residence with the warmth and flexibility of a true home.
STORY.BODY: With three strategically located branches across the city, we deliver a standardized, transparent management process — from registration and deposit to room handover — so residents never have to worry about financial clarity or housing security.

HOM.NAME: Hôm — Dedicated
HOM.DESC: We stand for fresh beginnings. From the very first question, we guide every resident into their new space with genuine care and attention.

SA.NAME: Sa — Warmth
SA.DESC: We stand for community energy. We nurture belonging through kindness, turning shared spaces into a second family.

DO.NAME: Đô — Transparency
DO.DESC: We stand for clarity in every transaction. From deposit to refund, every figure is documented, verified, and easy to trace.

BRANCHES.TITLE: 03 Strategic Branches
BRANCHES.SUBTITLE: Positioned in key districts to keep your commute short and your lifestyle convenient.
BRANCHES.CARD_DESC: Operating across key locations to provide the best accessibility for students and young professionals.

CONFIRMATION.TITLE: 24-Hour Confirmation
CONFIRMATION.CARD_DESC: Our streamlined system ensures that all booking and deposit requests are processed within a strict 24-hour window.

TRANSPARENCY.TITLE: 100% Financial Transparency
TRANSPARENCY.CARD_DESC: Every transaction, from the initial deposit to final refund reconciliation, is clearly documented and verified.

ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_INTRO: Please review our booking and residency policies:
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_RENT_DESC: Rent is due within the first 5 days of each month.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_DEPOSIT_DESC: A deposit equivalent to one month's rent is required to confirm your booking.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_CONFIRM_DESC: Your room is reserved only after the deposit has been received.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_REFUND_100: Full refund (100%) if cancelled 14 or more days before move-in.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_REFUND_70: 70% refund if cancelled 7–13 days before move-in.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_REFUND_50: 50% refund if cancelled 3–6 days before move-in.
ROOM_DETAIL.POLICY_REFUND_80: No refund for cancellations within 3 days of move-in.
